embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: CreativeFlow: A One-to-Many Analogical Relation Transfer Method for 3D Asset Generation
fields.value: Adobe Research — The paper presents CreativeFlow, an analogical generation framework inspired by cognitive science that explicitly models analogical divergent thinking to counter creative homogenization in text-to-3D pipelines.

fields.name: CleanMDM: Clean Motion Diffusion Model for Multimodal Motion Cleanup
fields.value: Alibaba — CleanMDM is a unified Clean Motion Diffusion Model that formulates motion-capture cleanup — removing jitter, missing segments, drift and contact artifacts — as masked conditional generation, accepting combinations of noisy 3D motion, sparse 2D/3D keyframes and text as plug-and-play conditions.

fields.name: Sparse-View 4D Gaussian Splatting via Spatiotemporal Priors and Generative Assistance
fields.value: JD.com — The paper presents a 4D Gaussian Splatting framework built for the Sparse-View Track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Volumetric Video Challenge, which requires dynamic scene reconstruction from only six wide-baseline cameras.

fields.name: Neuroll: Real-Time Neural Strand-Based Hair Simulation via Simulator-in-the-Loop Unrolling
fields.value: Meta; NVIDIA — The paper presents Neuroll, a neural time integrator for strand-based hair simulation designed to mirror the input-output formulation of classical time integrators (previous hair states, material stiffness, collision geometry).

fields.name: Lollypop: Camera-to-Motion-Capture Calibration Verification with a Reference Target
fields.value: Meta — The paper introduces Lollypop, a fiducial-mocap reference target that independently verifies camera-to-motion-capture (mocap) calibration.

fields.name: DistScene: Object-to-Scene Distillation for 3D Scene Generation
fields.value: TeleAI / China Telecom; other authors: HKUST. **FLAG: borderline** — DistScene generates compositional 3D scenes from a single image by jointly producing separate environment and object components in a unified coordinate system, then refining objects and distilling object-level generative priors into the scene.

fields.name: CurveCodec 2: Skeleton-agnostic animation compression with a learned entropy model
fields.value: Adobe Research — The paper presents CurveCodec 2, a skeleton-agnostic skeletal-motion compression codec that asks which part of a production codec a learned model should take over, building on the authors' earlier CurveCodec.

fields.name: SUAVE: Unified Video-Action Models via Masked Diffusion
fields.value: Toyota Research Institute — The paper presents SUAVE, a unified video-action model in which a masked diffusion transformer generates video and robot actions conditioned on language, with all three modalities represented as discrete tokens in one shared sequence.

fields.name: ProAR: Learning Prospective Reasoning with Autoregressive Video Models
fields.value: Microsoft — ProAR is a framework for autoregressive video (world) models that adds goal-directed, prospective reasoning on top of standard next-frame prediction.

fields.name: FlowHMR: Physically Plausible Motion Capture from Video
fields.value: Tencent — FlowHMR reframes monocular video human motion capture as a video-conditioned motion generation task, using flow matching to produce physically plausible 3D human motion from single-camera video.

fields.name: DuoMatching: Joint-Marginal Distribution Matching for Few-Step Video Generation
fields.value: ByteDance; Shijie Zhao is ByteDance-only corresponding author) — DuoMatching is a distillation framework for few-step video generation that combines joint distribution matching (video-level) with marginal distribution matching (frame-level, supervised by an image generator) to improve visual quality and semantic coherence.

fields.name: World Action Modeling with Progressive Visual Planning
fields.value: Meta — The paper introduces ProWAM, a world action model that jointly predicts future actions and an ordered sequence of sparse visual sub-goals from an initial observation and instruction, instead of generating dense full video rollouts.

fields.name: Spatial Memory Intelligence: Endowing World Models with Understanding-Driven Long-Term Memory
fields.value: Alibaba Group — The paper introduces Spatial Memory Intelligence (SMI), a framework that uses multimodal large language models' spatial-reasoning ability to manage long-term memory in long-video, action-conditioned world models.

fields.name: RelationVGGT: Visual Geometry Transformers for 3D Spatial Relation Segmentation
fields.value: NVIDIA — RelationVGGT is a feed-forward framework for 3D spatial relation segmentation: given a visually specified subject and a relational text query (with no category name provided), it segments the related target object across multiple views in a pose-free setting.

fields.name: OpenGameEval: Benchmarking Agentic Programming and Exploration in a Stateful Game Engine
fields.value: Roblox — The authors introduce OpenGameEval, a benchmark that evaluates LLM agents acting inside Roblox Studio on 84 curated game-development tasks (scripting and scene modification), each attempted 16 times by 13 frontier models.

fields.name: HiPhy: Hierarchical Alignment for Physically-Plausible Multi-Principle Video Generation
fields.value: Qualcomm AI Research — HiPhy is a reinforcement-learning framework for video generation that uses hierarchical reward structures to enforce the temporal dynamics of individual physical principles while keeping global scene coherence when several principles act at once.

fields.name: FutureWorlds: Learning Robotic World Models from Alternative Futures
fields.value: Tencent — FutureWorlds is a framework for learning robotic world models from "alternative futures": it unifies candidate future-scene construction, persistent memory for diverging trajectories, and learning from relative quality comparisons between candidates.
